LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing 3.2 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Character recognition • Simple descripti
Topic 3.4: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing 3.2 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Character recognition • Simple descripti in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How does sequence enhance written communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work with peers to search online or offline the strokes of Chinese characters and list them down,

2. write down the months of the year in the right sequence (一月、二 月、三月、四月、......十二月),

3. watch an audio-visual clip and practice writing the months of the year with characters,

4. rearrange scrambled up words and write the sentences in the correct order,

5. practise writing the given sentences correctly and identify areas that need improvement,

6. work jointly to discuss and write down important dates, events and holidays during the year and relate them with their respective months

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with peers to search online or offline the strokes of Chinese characters and list them down,
2. write down the months of the year in the right sequence (一月、二 月、三月、四月、......十二月),
3. watch an audio-visual clip and practice writing the months of the year with characters,
4. rearrange scrambled up words and write the sentences in the correct order,
5. practise writing the given sentences correctly and identify areas that need improvement,
6. work jointly to discuss and write down important dates, events and holidays during the year and relate them with their respective months

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: The learner connects to, and uses the internet to search for the strokes of Chinese characters with peers.

• Self-efficacy: Effective communication skills are developed as the learner identifies areas that need improvement in their

writing.

Values:
Patriotism is enhanced as the learner discusses the important dates, events and holidays in their own country.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship is promoted as the learner becomes aware and pays keen attention to the important dates, events and holidays that

take place in their country during the year.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Mathematics on the concept of using a numbering system to systematically organise time into

months.
